landing.heroTitle: Your shape, guided by an AI coach.
landing.heroBody: Profile, meals, gym, and progress in one simple flow: ask, adjust, save, and come back without chaos.

flow.step1Body: Weight, goal, activity, and available days. Forma doesn't guess your program.
flow.step2Body: Calories, meals, training, and your next step all tie to the same profile.
flow.step3Body: The coach answers based on your profile, and Premium can keep a memory of progress.

landing.nutritionTitle: Meals start with what you already have.
landing.nutritionBody: Free gets limited, useful ideas. Premium goes further: coherent plans and richer analysis.
landing.nutritionCard1Body: Type your products, get options that fit your target.
landing.nutritionCard2Body: Free estimates from text. Premium can also analyze a photo.
landing.nutritionCard3Body: A coherent meal plan, not ideas thrown around separately.
landing.workoutsTitle: The plan shapes itself around your week.
landing.workoutsBody: You pick the available days, and Forma fits the workouts into your schedule. No more random consecutive days.
landing.premiumBody: Premium stays hidden for Free users and unlocks only after payment confirmed via webhook.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: Forma is an organization tool for nutrition, workouts, and progress. Calorie estimates, macros, and AI recommendations are indicative.
terms.p2: The app does not replace a doctor, nutritionist, qualified trainer, or medical evaluation. For pain, symptoms, pregnancy, chronic illness, or a history of eating disorders, seek qualified help.
terms.p3: Premium access is granted only after real payment confirmation through the configured payment processor.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: Forma stores the data needed for your account: name, email, hashed password, profile, meals, plans, progress, and subscription status.
privacy.p2: API keys and payment secrets stay on the server. Premium access is verified via a signed webhook, not by the state of a button in the browser.
privacy.p3: You can request account deletion from your profile. For production, this page must be completed with the legal operator, retention period, and data controller contact.
